# Path regexes excluded from the TruffleHog secrets scan (one per line).

# Removed in 2022. Its history contains dummy JDBC URLs without credentials
# (Postgres JDBC URLs pointing to the test databases) that TruffleHog >= 3.97.9
# reports as "unknown" results on full-history scans.
^\.github/workflows/business-tests\.yaml$
